note: THE C7 WALK, executable (cinatra#2970, PR #2975).
C7 is the SETUP RUN PAGE of a run that has not started: the schedule step open with the
scheduler form in the detail column, and the two steps the run has not reached — the skills
recommendation and the review — muted and unselectable. Plan (A) §7.2 step 5 / §7.4 step 7:
the step 'opens to the right of the steps, never directly under a step, and no agentic run
progress card is shown with it'. The maintainer's ruling of 2026-08-25 (Option A) adds: a step
the run has not reached cannot be selected; its row stays on the rail, muted; clicking it does
nothing; the scheduler stays open; the right column never shows an empty step surface.
THE CELLS ARE NOT RECORDS OF THE CANONICAL LIFECYCLE-CARD INDEX, and this file says so rather
than declaring a record that would be refused at the shutter. Every record in
scripts/ci/chat-hitl-capture-index.json asserts `[data-lifecycle-card-host="<host>"]`
(`requiredAssertionsFor`, scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs). C7 is the shipped setup
trigger screen, which draws NO lifecycle card at all — that absence is half of what the cell
proves — so an index record for it could only be made by inventing an anchor. The S9d walk
(evidence/2788-s9d-rework/capture-walk.json) named the same boundary and left the picture to a
capture lane; this is that lane, and its records live beside these captures.
NOTHING HERE IS SEEDED. The run was created by the app's own dispatch out of a real
conversation with a real model provider (drivers/08-chat-run-parked.mjs, then its own setup step answered on the run page by drivers/09-answer-setup-step.mjs); this walk only opens
its page and presses two rows that must do nothing.
export WALK_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:<port>
export WALK_RUN_URL=/agents/<vendor>/<slug>/<runId>
node evidence/2970-setup-rail/drivers/06-capture-c7.mjs

steps.why: The setup run page as a person first meets it: the schedule step open, the two steps ahead of it muted.

cells.requires: the two-column run surface: the rail on the left carrying the run's three setup steps in order (their titles render EMPTY on this head — see README.md), the scheduler open in the detail column on the right, no agentic run progress beside it, and the recommendation and review rows muted and unselectable

steps.why: The ruling, pressed: the two muted rows are clicked in turn and must do nothing at all. The presses are FORCED because the rows carry aria-disabled — which is the very thing under proof: a browser automation that respects aria-disabled would never deliver the press, and a row that is never pressed proves nothing. The press is a real mouse click on the row the page draws.

cells.requires: the same page after both muted rows were pressed: the scheduler still open, the detail column unchanged, nothing selected that was not selected before

steps.why: The same page in dark, followed rather than re-navigated.
